findings: The November 7, 2026 base capture is a reader reboot-window introduction and an index of Dashboard and API variants. It establishes neither the procedural bodies nor a new device behavior.

The May 1, 2026 full guide describes a merchant setting a smart-reader window via local or inherited Dashboard configuration or Configuration API create/update. By default smart readers reboot every 24 hours at midnight. They use the registered location's local time and stagger reboots randomly during the specified window.

The May guide permits different start/end integers 0–23. A lower start is same-day and a larger start crosses midnight. Stripe sets the window within 10 minutes, and a reader already rebooted for the day uses the next period. The old summary captures most of this but omits the unequal-endpoint guard.
No functional delta is established. November substitutes linked Markdown variants for May's embedded Dashboard and API bodies. The feature description remains.
